Tudor is Rolex's diffusion brand. In the past, it was a brand that shared parts with Rolex and could experience the charm of Rolex at an attractive price. However, we stop the policy now and propose Tudor's original technique and design. And this model is the "Heritage Black Bay" that appeared in 2012. A popular model that adopted the "squid needle" and "small rose logo (Tudor Rose)" that existed in the former Tudor. In particular, the new model of the same series that appeared in 2016 has returned to the current standard "shield logo", so the popularity of this small rose logo model is likely to accelerate further. There are some small scratches, but it is in a beautiful state. We perform precision adjustment and exterior finishing. *Accessories may have scratches, stains, or deterioration.
